<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <Description>Azure Event Grid is a publish-subscribe service that allows cloud events to be passed from producers to consumers.
      This library contains the system event models used by Azure Event Grid. For more information about Event Grid, see https://azure.microsoft.com/services/event-grid.</Description>
    <AssemblyTitle>Azure EventGrid System Events client library</AssemblyTitle>
    <Version>1.2.0-beta.1</Version>
    <!--The ApiCompatVersion is managed automatically and should not generally be modified manually.-->
    <ApiCompatVersion>1.1.0</ApiCompatVersion>
    <PackageTags>Azure;Event Grid;CloudEvent;$(PackageCommonTags)</PackageTags>
    <TargetFrameworks>$(RequiredTargetFrameworks)</TargetFrameworks>
    <IncludeOperationsSharedSource>true</IncludeOperationsSharedSource>
    <DisableEnhancedAnalysis>true</DisableEnhancedAnalysis>
    <AotCompatOptOut>true</AotCompatOptOut>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Azure.Core" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="..\..\Azure.Messaging.EventGrid\EventGridSourceGenerator\src\Azure.Messaging.EventGrid.SourceGeneration.csproj" OutputItemType="Analyzer" ReferenceOutputAssembly="false" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

limitations: Coverage is partial: 17 distinct Customization source paths of 766 eligible files are supplied, out of 777 discovered files. Many additional customizations, generated partials, constructors, serializers, event-dispatch extensions and constants are excluded.

The explicit CodeGen attributes and Customization paths support handwritten provenance under the frozen .NET guideline, but no generator run, compiled output or released artifact was inspected. The empty internal partial AcsMessageChannelEventError and AcsRouterCommunicationError declarations are not separately counted as behavior without a supplied contrasting generated accessibility or an active mapping. Empty AppAction and AppServicePlanAction stubs map their names to the same names and have no demonstrated additional behavior; customization-path classification alone does not turn inert scaffolding into findings.

The comment claiming populated internal error properties is not independently verified; null source values, serialization exceptions, thread safety and cache invalidation are not assumed away.

Legacy enum-like types are counted once per complete type, including their constructor/constants/conversion/equality/display contract, rather than once per boilerplate member. Their case-insensitive Equals and ordinary string GetHashCode are described literally, not claimed to implement consistent case-insensitive hashing.

Factory overloads with the same actual method name are grouped in one finding rather than split through signature aliases. Complete public factory bodies count under the non-generated .NET guideline even when documented for mocking; called model constructor validation/defaulting and activation by consumers remain unobserved.

The factory's eleven suppression directives are grouped with its class-level mapping on the one declared factory identity. Suppressed method names appearing only as attribute strings are not invented as supplied method declarations, and replacement implementations outside the excerpt are not inferred.
